[[File:HandwrittenAurebesh-GBCC.jpg|thumb|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] writes on a piece of flimsiplast in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]].]]
{{Quote|Ha! Caught the enemy on a caf break. Prison defenses might as well be made of flimsiplast.|Oteg|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Flimsiplast''', often shortened to '''flimsi''', '''flimsy''', or sometimes '''plast''', was one of the most popular media for the written word. The hair-thin sheets of acrylic medium were almost transparent and were sometimes collected into hardbound [[Book/Legends|books]]. Flimsiplast was also used for printing hard-copies of computer files. Flimsi could also be used to make such items as disposable gowns in hospitals.<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

Flimsiplast was reusable, unlike [[Paper/Legends|paper]], but dissolved in liquids.<ref name="DJ">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''</ref>

A variety known as change flimsiplast could store multiple writings on the same surface; the reader could cycle through them by touching the surface in a certain manner.<ref name="Rogue Planet">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>
